data.body:
LANDED and closed out. Final state, all acceptance criteria verified.

Gerrit change 1483: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1483
  LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot), Verified +1 (rebar CI bot), 0 unresolved
  comments, submittable=true -> submitted. Status MERGED at 2026-08-07 10:32:15.
  Gerrit rebased server-side (Rebase-If-Necessary; patchset 2) onto 532a1329f6,
  so the merged sha differs from the pushed one.

MERGED COMMIT: 4bce6a3cca435f9d52dbe2e1969dd08cab605e29

AC1 PASS - pyproject on merged main: 'zizmor==1.29.0' (line 234); mcp still
  '>=1.28.1,<2' at lines 82 (mcp extra) and 198 (dev group).
AC2 PASS - uv.lock on merged main: zizmor 1.29.0, mcp 1.29.0. 'uv lock --check'
  exit 0 locally, and CI's own 'uv lock --check' step passed inside Verified +1.
AC3 PASS - make lint exit 0 (zizmor v1.29.0: 'No findings to report', 1
  suppressed); make typecheck exit 0 (436 files); full local suite
  10908 passed, 46 skipped, 228 deselected in 37m38s.
AC4 PASS - commit present on main carrying 'rebar-ticket: 7466-fe00-bfb3-4a71'.
AC5 PASS - 'gh pr view 125 --json state' -> CLOSED.
AC6 PASS - the closing comment (issuecomment-5215919097) contains both
  '4bce6a3cca435f9d52dbe2e1969dd08cab605e29' and '732b-51df-acf2-477b'.

Two local pytest ERRORs are explained, not defects: the repo-hygiene guards
('Test moved the repo HEAD c89a2ddcc4 -> a32fcbde7c' in
tests/unit/grounding/test_harness.py, and a '.tickets-tracker' REPO_ROOT leak in
tests/unit/grounding/test_oracle.py) fired because I committed into the worktree
while the suite was still running. The moved-HEAD sha the guard reported IS this
change's own commit. CI ran the same suite on a quiescent checkout and voted
Verified +1, which is the authoritative result.

No evidence was produced for bug 63e8 (committed lock turning transitive-dep
advisories into build stoppages), so nothing was posted there. The opposite
happened: CI's gating pip-audit step passed, and 'uv lock --upgrade-package
zizmor' behaved normally rather than no-op'ing, because zizmor is a direct,
uncapped dev pin - not the upstream-capped transitive case 63e8 describes.
